proof:
set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
  classical
  intro N inst v hv hNv
  have hN : 8 ≤ N := by
    rw [hNv]
    simpa using (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide : 0 < (2 : ℕ)) hv)
  have hEven : Even N := by
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k : ℕ, v = k + 1 := ⟨v - 1, by omega⟩
    rw [hNv, hk, pow_succ]
    exact ⟨2 ^ k, by omega⟩
  have hlit := M8.AntipodalFamily.literal_polynomial N hN hEven
  have hp := M8.AntipodalFamily.nontrivial N hN hEven
  have hd : M8.AntipodalFamily.polynomial N ∣ M6.Cyclic.modulus N := by
    rw [hNv]
    exact M8.AntipodalFamily.divides_modulus v hv
  let p := M8.AntipodalFamily.polynomial N
  let m := M6.Cyclic.modulus N
  have hs := (M7.RecipeSignature.signature_properties N (M8.AntipodalFamily.recipe N)).1
  have hleft : M7.RecipeSignature.signature (M8.AntipodalFamily.recipe N) ∣ p := by
    dsimp only [M7.RecipeSignature.signature, M8.AntipodalFamily.recipe]
    simp only [hlit]
    first
    | change gcd (gcd p p) m ∣ p
    | change gcd p (gcd p m) ∣ p
    | change gcd (gcd p m) p ∣ p
    | change gcd (gcd m p) p ∣ p
    | change gcd p (gcd m p) ∣ p
    | change gcd m (gcd p p) ∣ p
    solve
    | exact gcd_dvd_left _ _
    | exact gcd_dvd_right _ _
    | exact dvd_trans (gcd_dvd_left _ _) (gcd_dvd_left _ _)
    | exact dvd_trans (gcd_dvd_left _ _) (gcd_dvd_right _ _)
    | exact dvd_trans (gcd_dvd_right _ _) (gcd_dvd_left _ _)
  have hright : p ∣ M7.RecipeSignature.signature (M8.AntipodalFamily.recipe N) := by
    dsimp only [M7.RecipeSignature.signature, M8.AntipodalFamily.recipe]
    simp only [hlit]
    first
    | change p ∣ gcd (gcd p p) m
    | change p ∣ gcd p (gcd p m)
    | change p ∣ gcd (gcd p m) p
    | change p ∣ gcd (gcd m p) p
    | change p ∣ gcd p (gcd m p)
    | change p ∣ gcd m (gcd p p)
    simp only [dvd_gcd_iff, dvd_refl, show p ∣ m from hd, and_self]
  exact Polynomial.eq_of_monic_of_dvd_of_natDegree_le hp.1 hs hright
    (Polynomial.natDegree_le_of_dvd hleft hp.2.2.1)
